findings.claim: On the search page, a query that holds an in: name and becomes impossible and then possible again, with the in: key unchanged, resolves its in: names again and re-evaluates any in: Smart Collection with a new `now`, because `impossible` is a dependency of the resolution effect.
findings.impact: Take 'in:"Weekly" tag:x'. Typing '-tag:x' and then deleting it, or switching the page's type so that the kinds become impossible and back, reloads the collection and Smart Collection lists and re-evaluates Weekly: extra requests, a delay before results return, and, for a Smart Collection with a relative modified: part, possibly a different member set within one in: key. The search window keeps its held resolution (useFileSearch.ts:140,209-210 never clears resolutionRef on the impossible branch), so the page and the window behave differently for the same edit.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/folder/useFolderFiles.ts:291-296 sets inResolution to null whenever `impossible` is true. Line 333 lists `impossible` among the effect's dependencies [inKey, inRetryToken, driveName, impossible], so when the query turns possible again the effect re-runs, sets 'resolving' (line 299) and calls resolveInNames afresh (line 309) with modifiedNowRef.current, the new run's now. Before this change the dependencies were [inKey, inRetryToken, driveName]. I28 says only a change of the in: key, 再試行 or a reload resolves again, and that a q or type change does not. I29 says an in: Smart Collection is not evaluated again until the in: key changes.
findings.repro: not_reproduced (static reading). Render FolderBrowser with searchQuery 'in:"Weekly" tag:x' and wait for files/query. Rerender with 'in:"Weekly" tag:x -tag:x', then again with 'in:"Weekly" tag:x'. Expected under I28: the Weekly evaluation listing count stays the same. As read: a second evaluation listing and a second collections/smart-folders request are sent.

bucket_proposal.reason: A q or type change that leaves the in: key unchanged causes a new resolution and evaluation, which I28 (and I29 for the Smart Collection's now) excludes.

findings.proposed_fix: Keep the resolution state across an impossible stretch: skip starting a resolution while impossible, without clearing a resolution held for the same inKey, and drop `impossible` from the effect's restart trigger (or start the resolution only when inResolution?.key !== inKey).

specification_compliance: Backend: apply_file_filters ANDs every new condition (drives.py:489-585). exclude_tags uses the same fold table as tags. exclude_kinds is the negation of the same _kind_predicate union. exclude_folders negates _folder_subtree. exclude_collections and has_collection are bounded to the request drive. File.mime_type, file_type, filename and folder_path are NOT NULL in models.py:64-72, so NOT(...) does not drop rows through NULL logic.

FileMatchingRequest reuses the positive validators for the exclude_ keys and StrictBool for has_ (internal.py diff). The addon SearchFilter mirrors this with separately counted caps and `epub` in KINDS, and omits the new keys from the /files/matching body when they are unset (file_matching.py:287-311), which satisfies I1 for the addon body.

Parser: a single leading '-' after NFKC, NEGATABLE_OPERATORS, has: values, an excluded-kind cap of 8 and excluded folder/collection caps of 10 counted apart from the positive ones. These follow parsing steps 1-5 as read in searchQuery.ts:704-813.

Impossible check (searchQuery.ts:538-576) implements exactly the six listed conditions. It is applied on the page (useFolderFiles), in the window (useFileSearch:123-134), in evaluateSmartCollection, and in the launcher.

The -in: classification (inNameResolution.ts) refuses only a negated name that no collection carries and a Smart Collection carries. It short-circuits when every name is a collection. The in: key includes polarity. Saving or overwriting runs the check for -in: names as well (SmartFolderSaveButton.tsx:255,284).

ConditionMenu: the new entries and their disabled conditions match menu steps 1-3. The tag, kind, folder and collection lists leave out values held in either polarity, as well as folders inside an excluded folder and kinds that an excluded kind holds.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: On the search page, making an in: query impossible and then possible again by editing q or the page type re-resolves the in: names and re-evaluates in: Smart Collections, while the search window keeps its earlier resolution.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: A user who briefly types a contradicting token after an in: Smart Collection query sees the results reload more slowly than in the window, because the collection lists are fetched again and the Smart Collection is evaluated again.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: A -in: name that matches no collection of the drive (a typo, or another drive's collection) is sent as exclude_collection and silently excludes nothing, with no notice.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Typing '-in:Tirp' instead of '-in:Trip' lists the unfiltered results with an Exclude chip shown, so the user may believe the collection was excluded.

potential_unspecified_behavior.behavior: While the typed query in the search window is impossible, the launcher hides its Go to rows, folder jumps and tag suggestions and stops loading tag names.
potential_unspecified_behavior.reason: Typing 'tag:x -tag:x' in the window makes every jump and suggestion row disappear until the contradiction is removed.
